item.title: ‘I could finally be myself on the pitch’: The Story of Paul Loding and the Millwall Romans
item.description: After once fearing ostracization in the sport he had followed since childhood, Paul Loding now thrives at the helm of Millwall Football Club’s affiliated LGBT team — finding solace in the very game he once felt compelled to leave. Paul, an estate agent by day and long-time football fan, grew up in a football-centric household, and became an avid spectator and grassroots player. item.title: March Madness: CBS spotlights EFL Clubs with Mascot Madness competition
item.description: EFL fans have long known about the proud history of the football mascot. Quirky, crazy, cuddly - they come in all shapes and sizes. But now it’s time for all 72 EFL mascots to go big Stateside as CBS launches Mascot Madness this March! Which EFL mascot deserves to be crowned the winner? Find out how you can have your say below What is March Madness? March Madness is one of the biggest annual sporting events in the United States. It’s the end‑of‑season national tournament for college basketball.

item.title: Heffernan’s first EFL goal earns Harrogate valuable point against Cheltenham
item.description: Cathal Heffernan scored his first EFL goal as Harrogate Town continued their fight for safety with a hard‑earned draw against in‑form Cheltenham at The EnviroVent Stadium. The 20‑year‑old defender rose highest to nod home early in the second half, cancelling out Isaac Hutchinson’s opener and extending the Sulphurites’ unbeaten run to five matches.
